connector.name: Media Gen MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for OpenAI Images/Videos and Google GenAI (Veo) media generation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package media-gen-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the strato-space account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key (required for OpenAI image/video tools).

env.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
env.description: Google GenAI API key for Veo video tools.

env.name: GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI
env.description: Set to true to use Vertex AI for Google GenAI.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: GCP project id for Vertex AI.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION
env.description: GCP region for Vertex AI (e.g. us-central1).

env.name: MEDIA_GEN_DIRS
env.description: Comma-separated output directories for media files.

env.name: MEDIA_GEN_URLS
env.description: Comma-separated URL prefixes allowed for fetch tools.

env.name: MEDIA_GEN_MCP_URL_PREFIXES
env.description: Public URL prefixes for mapping local output files.

env.name: MEDIA_GEN_MCP_TEST_SAMPLE_DIR
env.description: Path to sample images for the test-images tool.
